accepted.name: band_transactions_clean
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "txhash" AS txhash,
  "block_height" AS block_height,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp_raw,
  "block_timestamp_truncated" AS block_timestamp_truncated,
  "transaction_type" AS transaction_type,
  "gas_wanted" AS gas_wanted,
  "gas_used" AS gas_used,
  "sender" AS sender,
  "fee" AS fee_variant,
  "memo" AS memo
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.TRANSACTIONS
accepted.description: Normalized projection of CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.TRANSACTIONS with cleaned aliases and parsed timestamp numeric -> unix epoch (if numeric) or preserved string; exposes core measures for reuse. Use this as the canonical transactions relation for BAND chain analyses, joins to messages/logs/oracle requests, and aggregations. | Use for: transaction counts and volume by sender or type; gas usage analysis over time; joining transactions to messages, logs, or oracle requests

accepted.name: band_messages_variants_flat
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "txhash" AS txhash,
  "block_height" AS block_height,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp_raw,
  "block_timestamp_truncated" AS block_timestamp_truncated,
  "message_type" AS message_type,
  "oracle_Activate" AS oracle_Activate,
  "oracle_AddReporter" AS oracle_AddReporter,
  "oracle_CreateDataSource" AS oracle_CreateDataSource,
  "oracle_CreateOracleScript" AS oracle_CreateOracleScript,
  "oracle_EditDataSource" AS oracle_EditDataSource,
  "oracle_EditOracleScript" AS oracle_EditOracleScript,
  "oracle_Report" AS oracle_Report,
  "oracle_Request" AS oracle_Request,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgDelegate" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgDelegate,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgEditValidator" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgEditValidator,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgMultiSend" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgMultiSend,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgSend" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgSend,
  "oracle_RemoveReporter" AS oracle_RemoveReporter,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgBeginRedelegate" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgBeginRedelegate,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgCreateValidator" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgCreateValidator,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgDeposit" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgDeposit,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgFundCommunityPool" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgFundCommunityPool,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgModifyWithdrawAddress" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgModifyWithdrawAddress,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgSubmitEvidence" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgSubmitEvidence,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgSubmitProposal" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgSubmitProposal,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgUndelegate" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgUndelegate,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgUnjail" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgUnjail,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgVerifyInvariant" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgVerifyInvariant,
  "cosmos_sdk_MsgVote" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgVote,

  "cosmos_sdk_MsgWithdrawValidatorCommission" AS cosmos_sdk_MsgWithdrawValidatorCommission
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.MESSAGES
accepted.description: Flattened projection of CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.MESSAGES preserving message-level identity and exposing the many VARIANT message columns as-is for later LATERAL FLATTEN or JSON path access. Keep one row per original message record (txhash + message_type) to support message-level analyses and joins to transactions/logs. | Use for: extracting oracle request/report payloads from messages; counting message types per transaction or per block; joining messages to BAND transactions or logs

accepted.name: band_oracle_requests_exploded_reports
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "oracle_request_id" AS oracle_request_id,
  "block_height" AS block_height,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp_raw,
  "block_timestamp_truncated" AS block_timestamp_truncated,
  r.value AS report_element
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.ORACLE_REQUESTS,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "reports") r
accepted.description: Explode the CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.ORACLE_REQUESTS.reports VARIANT array into one row per report while preserving request-level identifiers. Useful to analyze individual report values, counts of reporters per request, or to join reports to decoded_result. | Use for: per-request reporter counts and distributions; inspection of individual report payloads for quality checks; joining individual reports to decoded results or oracle scripts

accepted.name: band_oracle_requests_exploded_decoded
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "oracle_request_id" AS oracle_request_id,
  "block_height" AS block_height,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp_raw,
  "block_timestamp_truncated" AS block_timestamp_truncated,
  d.value AS decoded_element
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.ORACLE_REQUESTS,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "decoded_result") d
accepted.description: Flatten CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.ORACLE_REQUESTS.decoded_result VARIANT array/object into rows for downstream analysis. Exposes decoded_result elements alongside request id for joins and aggregations. | Use for: reconstructing final oracle outputs per request; validating decoded results vs raw reports; extracting numeric or textual results from decoded payloads

accepted.name: eth_transactions_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "hash" AS hash,
  "block_hash" AS block_hash,
  "block_number" AS block_number,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp,
  "from_address" AS from_address,
  "to_address" AS to_address,
  "value" AS value,
  "gas" AS gas_limit,
  "gas_price" AS gas_price,
  "receipt_gas_used" AS gas_used,
  "receipt_contract_address" AS receipt_contract_address,
  "receipt_status" AS receipt_status,
  "transaction_index" AS transaction_index
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TRANSACTIONS
accepted.description: Clean projection of CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TRANSACTIONS exposing main identifiers and gas/fee metrics for ETH chain analyses and joins to logs/traces/contracts/token_transfers. | Use for: transaction fee and gas analyses; join to logs/traces/token_transfers/contracts by tx hash or contract address; counting transactions per block or per address

accepted.name: eth_token_transfers_by_tx
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "transaction_hash" AS transaction_hash,
  COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
  SUM(TRY_TO_NUMBER("value")) AS transfer_value_sum
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TOKEN_TRANSFERS
GROUP BY "transaction_hash"
accepted.description: Aggregate CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TOKEN_TRANSFERS to compute per-transaction token transfer counts and summed numeric value (value is string in schema; consumer should cast if numeric). Useful for identifying token-heavy transactions and joining to transactions/blocks. | Use for: find transactions with many token transfers; measure total token value transferred per transaction; join token transfer aggregates to transactions for enrichment

accepted.name: btc_outputs_exploded_addresses
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "transaction_hash" AS transaction_hash,
  "index" AS output_index,
  "block_hash" AS block_hash,
  "block_number" AS block_number,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp,
  o.value AS address_element,
  "value" AS value
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.OUTPUTS,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "addresses") o
accepted.description: Explode CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.OUTPUTS.addresses VARIANT (array) into one row per output-address pair while retaining output identifiers and value. Useful for UTXO-level address analytics and joining to inputs/spend events. | Use for: UTXO ownership and address-level balances (approximate); counting outputs per address or value distributions; matching outputs to later inputs by transaction and index

accepted.name: btc_inputs_linked_spends
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  i."transaction_hash" AS spending_transaction_hash,
  i."index" AS spending_input_index,
  i."block_number" AS spending_block_number,
  i."block_timestamp" AS spending_block_timestamp,
  i."spent_transaction_hash" AS spent_transaction_hash,
  i."spent_output_index" AS spent_output_index,
  o."value" AS spent_output_value,
  o."addresses" AS spent_output_addresses,
  o."block_number" AS spent_output_block_number,
  o."block_hash" AS spent_output_block_hash
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.INPUTS i
LEFT JOIN CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.OUTPUTS o
  ON i."spent_transaction_hash" = o."transaction_hash"
  AND i."spent_output_index" = o."index"
accepted.description: Join CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.INPUTS to CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.OUTPUTS on spent transaction hash/index to produce explicit spend join rows (one row per input showing source output details). Useful for tracing UTXO flows. | Use for: trace UTXO flow from outputs to later inputs; identify spent outputs and compute spend delays/value; reconstruct address-level flows by exploding addresses after this join

accepted.name: eth_contracts_latest_by_address
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "address" AS address,
  "bytecode" AS bytecode,
  "function_sighashes" AS function_sighashes,
  "is_erc20" AS is_erc20,
  "is_erc721" AS is_erc721,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp,
  "block_number" AS block_number,
  "block_hash" AS block_hash,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY "address"
    ORDER BY "block_number" DESC NULLS LAST, "block_timestamp" DESC NULLS LAST
  ) AS rn
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.CONTRACTS

semantic_filters.rn: use rn = 1 in downstream WHERE to get latest per address

accepted.description: Select the latest CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.CONTRACTS row per address using block_number ordering. Exposes is_erc20/is_erc721 flags and block context so consumers can restrict to latest known contract metadata. | Use for: list latest contract metadata for each address; identify ERC20/ERC721 contracts; join latest contract info to token transfers or transactions

SELECT

accepted.description: Normalized projection of CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.LOGS with core identifiers and topic list variant preserved for filtering or LATERAL FLATTEN. One row per log. | Use for: filter logs by topic/address; join logs to token transfers or transactions; extract event parameters via LATERAL FLATTEN on topics or data

accepted.name: ethtx_token_transfer_join
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.hash AS transaction_hash,
  t.block_number AS block_number,
  t.block_timestamp AS block_timestamp,
  t.from_address AS from_address,
  t.to_address AS to_address,
  coalesce(tt.transfer_count, 0) AS token_transfer_count,
  coalesce(tt.transfer_value_sum, 0) AS token_transfer_value_sum
FROM (
  SELECT
    "hash" AS hash,
    "block_number" AS block_number,
    "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp,
    "from_address" AS from_address,
    "to_address" AS to_address
  FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TRANSACTIONS
) t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    "transaction_hash" AS transaction_hash,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    SUM(TRY_TO_NUMBER("value")) AS transfer_value_sum
  FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TOKEN_TRANSFERS
  GROUP BY "transaction_hash"
) tt
  ON t.hash = tt.transaction_hash
accepted.description: Join token transfer aggregates (per transaction) to ETH transactions to produce enriched transaction-level rows with token transfer counts and sums. Uses eth_transactions_basic and eth_token_transfers_by_tx concepts (token value cast may be required). | Use for: identify transactions that moved tokens; enrich transaction lists with token transfer metrics; filter for token-intensive transactions
